grid=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in test.splitlines()]
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    centers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,3)]
    # Color entire rows, then columns; original marks are preserved and vertical strokes win crossings.
    for r,c,color in centers:
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=color
    for r,c,color in centers:
        for i in range(h):
            if grid[i][c]==0: out[i][c]=color
    return out
out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
